# eKYC Pro Apple Checker API
> Official integration context generated from the checked API expansion manifest.

## Canonical resources
- [apple](https://docs.ekycpro.com/apple-number-checker)
- [apple_email](https://docs.ekycpro.com/apple-email-checker)

## Contract facts
- API base URL: https://api.ekycpro.com
- Authentication: `X-API-Key` request header
- API key environment variable: `EKYCPRO_API_KEY`
- Processing mode: sync_single
- Current prices are not embedded; use the official pricing page.

## Products
- `apple`: Apple Checker · input `phone` · fields: id, identifier, registered, billed, cost, cost_usd
- `apple_email`: Apple Email Checker · input `email` · fields: id, identifier, registered, billed, cost, cost_usd

## Safety
- Process only identifiers you are authorized to verify.
- Do not expose API keys in browser code or commit secrets.
- An undetermined result is not a confirmed negative.

Last reviewed: 2026-08-18.
